user_query: I'm planning a company retreat and I need some ideas for team-building activities. Can you suggest some popular languages that we can learn together as a team? Additionally, I would like to download Instagram videos showcasing successful team-building events for inspiration. Your help is highly appreciated.

TaskList.description: Research popular programming languages that are suitable for team learning.
Gather resources and suggestions for team-building activities related to the chosen languages.
Search and retrieve Instagram videos that showcase successful team-building events.
Compile a list of the languages and team-building activities along with the downloaded Instagram video links.
